Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from the coverage of this exciting series. West Indies have clinched the series by a 3-2 margin and they pose for some pictures now with the trophy. Happy faces in the Windies camp and rightly so as they have played some brilliant cricket in this series. The cricketing action does not stop here as we bring you the live coverage of Bangladesh Premier League, Pakistan Super League and the remainder of the Under-19 World Cup. So make sure you tune in for all these games and enjoy all the live action. See you there! Cheers!

Jason Holder is the Player of the Match as well as the Series. He says that it was a classy finish. Tells that he didn't bowl well in the previous game and he is happy with his performance in this game. Mentions that he was pumped and always loves to play at the Kensington Oval. He also appreciates the English crowd for flying down here and thanks the home crowd as well for supporting them throughout the series. Tells that he knew that he needed to improve his death bowling and he worked very hard in the nets to get better at it. On his relationship with Kieron Pollard, he says that he enjoys playing with him and he always thinks about the team and not about himself. Signs off by thanking Moeen Ali, Eoin Morgan and ECB for all of their efforts and says that he is looking forward to the Test series against England.

Kieron Pollard, the victorious skipper of West Indies, starts by singing a song. He thanks his team for giving this victory and applauds his team for supporting each other. He mentions that the boys have worked tirelessly and they had a talk about how to go about things ahead and says credit should be given to all the boys for the effort they have put in. He tells that this was like a final and runs on the board are always crucial and they started well but failed to get going in middle overs. He says that the move to send Shepherd did not work and after that sometimes they have to consolidate. Signs off by saying that this was a total team effort and he is very proud of the way his team played.

Moeen Ali, the skipper of England, says that West Indies were a better team and they played well. He adds that it has been good series. He mentions that they played well in the death overs and England will learn from this and get better. He informs that the new ball comes nicely on the bat and then it becomes difficult. He says that the younger guys did well in the series and they are proud of their performances in these conditions. He adds that West Indies were a smarter team today and that was the difference in the end. Mentions that he enjoys captaincy but Morgan is a brilliant captain and he doesn’t think much about captaincy.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

West Indies will be extremely pleased with the way they bowled and kept the English batters in check for the majority of the innings. Akeal Hosein set the tone upfront as he got rid of Jason Roy in the first over. They did leak some runs in the middle overs but it was the second spell of Akeal Hosein which turned the game in West Indies' favour. However, it was Jason Holder who stole the entire show in the last over in which he picked up four wickets to hand England a series defeat. He also went on to become the first West Indian to grab a hat-trick in T20Is. All in all, it was a good overall display from the hosts and they deserved to win the match as well as the series.

England had to chase 180 from 20 overs and they had to start well with the bat which they did as Jason Roy made his intentions quite clear in the first over but he also perished in the same over and England were put on the back foot. Although, Banton and Vince did steady the ship but once Banton was dismissed, England lost the momentum and they kept losing wickets after that. No batter managed to get in and get going and Vince was the lone warrior out there in the middle. Their skipper, Moeen Ali who batted so well in the previous game looked completely out of sorts in this one as he never really got going and took 19 deliveries to score just 14 runs. Billings swung his willow in the end but he ran out of partners and as a result he too lost his wicket in the last over. England would be disappointed with the way they batted in this decider.

Jason Holder seals the deal for West Indies and the hosts clinch the T20I series 3-2! Incredible scenes at Kensington Oval and the West Indian players get into a huddle to celebrate of what has been a terrific T20I series. England were in this contest at the halfway mark but once they started to lose wickets post that, they never looked like chasing it down and in the end they were just blown away by the brilliance of Jason Holder.

OUT! BOWLED! FOUR IN FOUR for Jason Holder! He nails a yorker this time and West Indies have bowled out England here! They are ecstatic but at first they didn't realise that Saqib Mahmood was bowled but then later, they do and the celebrations go a notch higher. Jason Holder bowls a yorker on leg. Saqib Mahmood looks to dig it out but misses. The ball hits the leg stump and the bails come off. So Holder finishes with a five-wicket haul and West Indies win by 17 runs!
Reece Topley is the last man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Hat-trick for Jason Holder and he has sealed the deal for West Indies here! A length ball, on off. Adil Rashid goes for a big heave across the line. He miscues it.The ball goes high in the air towards deep mid-wicket and the fielder there Odean Smith takes a good catch. Jason Holder becomes the first West Indian to take a hat-trick in T20Is.
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Saqib Mahmood is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Jason Holder gets his man and that should be it for England! Holder serves a slower ball, fuller in length, outside off. Sam Billings shuffles across and looks to heave it to the leg side but it goes off the top edge, high in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Hayden Walsh (sub) settles under it and he makes no mistake. Holder is elated and England's last hope, Billings takes the long walk back to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Hayden Walsh b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Adil Rashid walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chris Jordan is disappointed but Jason Holder is pumped up! A slower full toss on off. Jordan heaves it towards deep mid-wicket and the fielder there Hayden Walsh (sub)takes a good catch. It is upto Sam Billings now to take England home but it looks like a very tough task now. West Indies are just a few good deliveries away now from a series win.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Hayden Walsh b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: Brilliant from Holder! A wide yorker outside off. Jordan backs away and in the end fails to get any bat on it.
NO BALL! Jason Holder has overstepped here! A low full toss on off. Sam Billings heaves it to long off for just a single. Free Hit coming up.
Jason Holder to bowl the last over. Will he defend 20 runs?
Just a single and 20 needed now from the last over! An excellent over from Sheldon Cottrell! He bowls this very full on off. Sam Billings only manages it to hit it to long off for a single.
Ohh..a dot ball! A length delivery outside off. Sam Billings swings across the line but misses.
NO BALL! A yorker gone wrong and a beamer on off. Billings swings hard but mistimes it to mid-wicket and gets back for the second run.

Review! Kieron Pollard has opted for a review for LBW! Has Sheldon Cottrell taken the big wicket of Sam Billings? No, he hasn't! The Ball Tracker confirms that the impact was well outside off and it is NOT OUT! West Indies lose a review!

NOT OUT! A low full toss, outside off. Sam Billings gets across and looks to sweep but misses. The ball hits his pads and goes towards the mid-wicket region. The batters run two before Sheldon Cottrell cuts it off. There was an appeal when the ball hit his pads but the umpire was unmoved. West Indies take a review. The Ball Tracker rolls and it shows that the impact is outside off so Billings is safe and they get two leg byes.
Just a single now! A length delivery on off. Jordan heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single. He looks for a second but decides against it.
Good delivery! A yorker outside off. Jordan looks to dig it out but fails to do so.
Slight halt in play! Kyle Mayers is being taken off the field by the physio as he seems to have hurt his hamstring!
A fuller delivery on off. Sam Billings drives it to covers for a single.
Sheldon Cottrell (2-0-15-0) comes into the attack.
FOUR! Boundary to end the over and 20 runs from it. Back of a length, on off. Jordan pulls it to deep square leg for a boundary. 28 needed now from 12 balls.
A fuller delivery on off. Drilled to long off now.

SIX! Good effort by Fabian Allen in the deep but the ball goes over him! A length ball, on off. Sam Billings heaves it across the line towards deep mid-wicket and the ball goes high in the air. Fabian Allen there dives over the ropes to catch it but fails to do so and a maximum for Sam Billings.
On a length and slower in pace this time. Sam Billings swings it across the line but misses.

In the air...but safe! Odean Smith bowls this full and outside off. Sam Billings gets across and sweeps it. He gets a top edge and the ball goes over the short fine leg fielder. The fielder cuts it off and the batters run a couple.

SIX! What a shot! Odean Smith bowls this fuller on middle and leg. Sam Billings stays deep in his crease and whips this off his legs over deep square leg for a biggie. Can Sam Billings take his side over the line?
WIDE! Slower and down the leg side. Sam Billings lets it go.
Odean Smith (3-0-21-1) is back on.
On the pads. Billings works it to fine leg for a single. 48 needed now from 18 balls.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary this! Fuller on off. Sam Billings gets low and slog-sweeps it towards cow corner for a boundary. Good shot!
Darted on the pads. Jordan looks to clip it but misses.The ball hits his pad and a leg bye is taken towards short fine leg.
Shorter and quicker on off. Jordan chops it to extra cover.
Just a single again! A flatter delivery on middle. Sam Billings skips down the track and mistimes his heave towards long on for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Jordan drills it to long off for a single.
Short and flatter delivery around off. Sam Billings cuts it to deep cover for a couple. 56 needed now from 24 balls.
Uppish but safe! Flatter ball, shorter in length and outside off. Sam Billings cuts hard and the ball goes just over the backward point fielder. The batters collect a couple of runs.
Tossed up, outside off. Sam Billings looks for a reverse sweep but he fails to get any blade on it.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Chris Jordan pushes it to the off side and takes a single.
An edge there! A flatter delivery on off. Jordan looks to defend but gets an outside edge to short third man.
Chris Jordan is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! Akeal Hosein gets another one and the left-arm spinner has got a wicket in each of his four overs. A tossed up delivery, around off. Philip Salt dances down the track and looks to go big across the line but misses it completely. The ball goes back to the keeper and Pooran whips the bails off in a flash. A big wicket this and the pressure is building up on England now.
Commentary.Howout: st Nicholas Pooran b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Play and a miss! Flatter ball, on a length, outside off and going on with the arm. Sam Billings stays back to cut but he misses. 61 runs needed off 30 balls!
On a length, around middle and leg. Sam Billings nudges it to the leg side and comes back for the second run. Good aggressive running from these two!
Slower through the air, on a length, outside off. Philip Salt cuts it to deep cover for a run.
Swing and a miss! Slightly quicker and fuller in length, outside off. Philip Salt looks for a sweep but he misses.
Floated, fuller in length, around middle. Sam Billings whips it towards the leg side and collects only a single.
On a length, darted on the pads. Philip Salt nudges it to the leg side and takes a single.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off. Salt looks to play it across the line but it goes off the leading edge back over the bowler's head. The batters take a run. 66 runs needed off 36 balls now.
Nicely tossed up, around off. Philip Salt presses forward to block it out.
Flatter ball, outside off. Sam Billings punches this off the back foot to sweeper cover for a run.
Philip Salt joins Sam Billings in the middle now.

OUT! TAKEN! Akeal Hosein strikes yet again and it is the set batter, James Vince who has to walk back to the hut now! This was tossed up, around off. Vince gets down on his knee to sweep. It goes off the top edge high in the air towards deep mid-wicket. Fabian Allen there, one of the best West Indian fielder, settles under it and makes no mistake. England slip further.
Commentary.Howout: c Fabian Allen b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Hammered but for no run! Short ball, outside off. Vince cuts hard but straight to the man at extra cover.
Flatter ball, around off. Sam Billings works it through the point region and hands the strike back to Vince.
Play and a miss! Flatter ball, going on with the arm from outside off. James Vince looks to cut but the ball is too close to cut and so he misses. 69 runs needed off 42 balls.
On a length, just outside off. James Vince taps it to backward point.
Short ball, outside off. Sam Billings cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter ball, on a length, around off and spinning away late. Sam Billings stays back to block but it goes off the outside edge towards the third man region. Two taken!
Tossed up, outside off. Sam Billings prods and drives it wide of long off for a couple of runs.
Flatter and quicker, around off. Sam Billings taps it to backward point.
Fabian Allen is into the attack now.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Another ball, shorter in length, outside off. James Vince rocks back and punches it hard through the cover region. The fielder in the deep gets to the ball but fails to prevent the boundary.
FOUR! WHACKED! A short ball, coming on with the arm from off. James Vince rocks back and pulls it hard in front of square to collect a boundary. Fifty for Vince! Top knock from him so far!
Slightly shorter in length, outside off. James Vince rocks back and cuts it towards deep cover for a couple of runs.
Sam Billings is off the mark straightaway! A fuller delivery on off. Sam Billings drives it to long off for a single.
Sam Billings walks out at number 6.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! This is a quicker ball, on a length, outside off. Liam Livingstone stays back and cuts hard but it goes off the outer half of the blade and straight to Odean Smith at backward point who takes a dolly. England are in deep trouble now as they lose Livingstone.
Commentary.Howout: c Odean Smith b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter ball, outside off. James Vince cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Akeal Hosein is back into the attack. He went for 10 runs in his first over but got a crucial wicket of Jason Roy.

FOUR! Now that spoils a good over! Holder hurls a slower ball, into the surface, around leg. Liam Livingstone looks to pull but it goes off the tope edge and flies past the keeper and into the fence. End of an eventful over from Holder!
Fuller in length, outside off. James Vince drives it towards long off. A single taken!
A slower ball, fuller in length, around middle. Liam Livingstone nudges it towards deep mid-wicket and settles for a single.
On a length, around leg. James Vince tucks it to the leg side and takes a run.
Short of a length, outside off. Liam Livingstone steers it to third man and gets off the mark with a run.
Liam Livingstone is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jason Holder strikes straight after the drinks break and gets rid of England's skipper! He serves a slower ball, into wicket, outside off. Moeen Ali stays back and looks to go over cover but it goes off the toe end straight to Kyle Mayers at short extra cover who takes a sharp catch. Huge moment in this game.
Commentary.Howout: c Kyle Mayers b Jason Holder

Commentary.Commentary: DRINKS! The game looks evenly poised at the moment and England have done well to keep wickets in hand. But having said that, one of the these two batters will need to get a move on as the asking rate is more than 9 and they still have a lot of batters waiting in the hut. West Indies haven't given away easy runs but they will now look to chip in with wickets. Jason Holder is back into the attack. He went for 17 runs in his first over.

Another dot ball and there is an edge there but the ball doesn't carry to the keeper. A shorter delivery delivery, outside off. Vince backs away and looks to guide it towards the third man region. He gets an under edge and the ball falls short of the keeper, Nicholas Pooran. 94 needed now from 60 balls.
Back of a length, around off at 141 kph. Vince dabs it towards backward point.
FOUR! Superb shot by Vince! This is full and around leg. Vince backs away and drives it left of mid off and beats the diving fielder for a boundary.
On a length, on middle. Ali looks to heave it away but gets an inside edge onto his pads. A single is taken towards the leg side.
Top edge but safe! A short delivery on middle at 140 kph. Ali looks to pull but gets a top edge. The ball goes in the air behind the keeper and the batters come back for the second run.
A length delivery on middle. Vince works it to deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Vince dabs it towards backward point for a single. 102 runs needed from 66 balls now.
A fuller delivery on off. Moeen Ali drives it towards the fielder at extra cover and takes a single.
WIDE! This is full and too wide outside off. Ali leaves it alone.
A length ball, around off. Vince chops it towards covers for a single.
On a length and around off. Vince steers it to backward point.

Back of a length, around off. Ali steers it through the backward point region. He gets it in the gap but Akeal Hosein does well there to stop it with a dive near the fence. A run saved for his team. Three runs taken by the batting team.
WIDE! Full this time but it is too wide outside off. Ali lets it go.
On a length, on middle. Vince works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A single to end the over! A length ball, on middle. Vince works it to mid-wicket for a single. West Indies had exactly the same score after 8 overs!
On a length, on off. Ali works it to long on for a single.
A slower delivery now at 116 kph. He bowls this on a length, outside off. Ali drives it to the cover fielder in the ring.
Shorter and around off. Ali punches this off the back foot to deep extra cover for a couple.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side this time. Ali looks to pull but misses.
On a length, on off at 134 kph. Vince defends it towards the off side and takes a quick single.
Back of a length, around leg at 136 kph. Ali tucks it to short fine leg for a single. Good running there.
On a length, on off. Ali cuts it to deep cover for a single. 118 needed now from 78 balls.
An off-pace delivery, on a length and outside off. Ali swings across the line but misses.
Back of a length, on off and Pollard gets some extra bounce now. Ali defends it out off the back foot.
On a length, around off. Ali steers it straight to the man at backward point.
On a length, on middle. Vince works it to mid-wicket now for a single.
FOUR! Shot! A gentle short delivery, outside off. Vince cuts it through point for a boundary.

Odean Smith finds the outside edge of Moeen Ali's blade again! A length delivery around off at 144 kph. Ali looks to push at it but the ball catches the outside edge of his blade and falls short of Holder at first slip this time.
A low full toss now on middle over 140 clicks again. Vince pushes it to mid on for a single.
Another pacy delivery and shorter in length on off at 143 kph. Vince looks to upper cut it but misses.
Back of a length at 149 kph. Vince steers it to the deep backward point region and gets back for a couple of runs.
Back of a length, around off. Ali plays it late and towards third man for a single.
A fuller delivery on off. Ali drives but gets a thick outside edge to backward point.
FOUR! Deft touch! Back of a length, around off. Vince stays back, opens the face of his bat and just guides it past the fielder at short third man. The ball races away to the fence.
Good-length ball, around off. James Vince taps it to the off side.
FOUR! Excellent timing and even better placement from Vince! This is a length ball, just outside off. Vince hangs back and caresses it through the gap at cover-point to bag a boundary.
A slower ball, fuller in length, around off. James Vince prods and pushes it to the fielder at cover-point. No run there.
Back of a length, around middle. James Vince nudges it behind square on the leg side and comes back for the second run. Good running!
On the pads now. Ali looks to clip it but misses. The ball hits his pads and a leg bye is taken towards the leg side.
Short ball this time from Odean Smith on off. Ali pulls it aerially towards deep square leg for a single. A successful over from Odean Smith.

DROPPED! Oh, dear! That could have been two in two for Smith! Holder drops a sitter and Moeen Ali survives! This was a length ball, around off and taking off from a length. Ali stays back to block but there is some extra bounce and it goes off the outside edge towards the left of Holder at first slip. He gets a hand to it and puts it down. How costly will it be for West Indies?
The skipper, Moeen Ali walks out at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! England lose their second wicket and it is Odean Smith who strikes now for West Indies. A short ball from Smith, around off. Banton looks to pull but he only manages a top edge which goes in the air towards the mid-wicket region. Jason Holder there, runs behind and takes a simple catch. England in a slight spot of bother now as they lose both their openers.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Holder b Odean Smith

Commentary.Commentary: Good-length delivery, around off. Tom Banton blocks it out off the front foot.
NASTY! A short ball, around middle. Tom Banton looks to pull but he misses and gets hit near his rib-cage.
Wide! Back of a length, angling down leg. Tom Banton misses his pull and the umpire stretches his arms to call it a wide.
SIX! BANG! This was a full ball, drifting onto the pads. Banton stays back and whips it way over the deep square leg region to fetch himself a maximum.
Wide! A full ball, down leg. Tom Banton looks to flick but he misses and the umpire signals a wide.
Odean Smith comes on to bowl now. He replaces Jason Holder.
On a length, outside off. Tom Banton punches it towards cover. Odean Smith there does well to stop it by diving to his left. A single taken. A tidy start from Cottrell, just 5 runs off it.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Another ball, banged into the deck, around off. Tom Banton stays back and pulls it wide of the mid on fielder to collect a boundary.
A short ball, outside off. Tom Banton looks to pull but it goes off the shoulder of his bat towards the mid on fielder. Four dots in a row!
Good-length ball, angling in slightly from off. Tom Banton covers the line of the ball to block it towards cover.
On a length, outside off and angling across the batter. Banton stays back to cut but he fails to get any bat on it yet again.
Play and a miss! Short of a length, outside off. Tom Banton stays back to cut but he misses.

FOUR! STREAKY! Good-length ball, way outside off. James Vince looks to punch it through the off side but it goes off the outside edge and flies past the keeper for a boundary. 17 runs off the over and England are off to a flier!
Back of a length, around off. James Vince taps it to backward point.
SIX! CLASSY! Full ball, around off. Vince gets behind the line of the ball and lofts it straight over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Another ball, drifting onto the pads. Vince glances it towards short fine leg where Sheldon Cottrell fumbles and the batters collect a couple of runs.
On a length, around off. Banton taps it to the off side and takes off for a quick run. Good sensible batting from the youngster!
FOUR! Easy pickings! A length ball, around leg. Tom Banton stays back and clips it behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Jason Holder will start from the other end.
Misfield allows Vince to get off the mark. A shorter delivery on off. Vince cuts it to covers. Smith there misfields and a couple of runs are taken. End of an eventful first over!
James Vince walks in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent catch from Pooran to get rid of the dangerous Roy! Akeal Hosein serves an arm ball, on a length, around middle. Roy looks for a sweep but he only manages a thick inside edge onto his pad. The ball pops up in the air just in front of Roy. Nicholas Pooran behind the sticks is quick to move forward and he puts in a dive to take a good catch. This is a huge wicket for West Indies!
Commentary.Howout: c Nicholas Pooran b Akeal Hosein

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around middle. Jason Roy nudges it to mid-wicket.
Flatter ball, around off. Roy taps it to the off side.
FOUR! AND AGAIN! Just a tad short, around off. Roy rocks back and cuts it hard past the cover fielder. The ball races away to the fence. Roy is making his intensions very clear at the start.
FOUR! Roy means business! Hosein tosses it up, around off. Roy stays back and lofts it over mid off for a boundary. England are up and running!
